title: Tidy a username with field_validator
summary: Strip and lower-case a field with a Pydantic v2 validator, then reject it when nothing is left.

files.content:
from pydantic import BaseModel


class SignupForm(BaseModel):
    email: str
    username: str

turns.user: signup lets usernames like " Mpyw " straight into the db. trim it and lowercase it

assistant.body: Sure. In v2 the best practice is field_validator rather than the old validator, with classmethod stacked underneath it. By default it runs after the type check, so value arrives as a str.

turns.user: a username of only spaces gets through as an empty string. reject that

assistant.body: Raise a ValueError and Pydantic wraps it in a ValidationError for you, so FastAPI answers 422 on its own. Note: the empty check has to come after strip.
